purpose: Reconcile differing XRP fund universes and document the current ETF-flow methodology. The tracker refresh is a repeat observation from an existing canonical source; CryptoSlate is derivative of XRP Insights, not independent flow corroboration; CorpStacking uses a different direct-XRP fund universe. Ingest only after the sharded-ledger validator and regression tests pass.

observed_claims.tracker_universe: six US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW
observed_claims.flow_exclusion: GXRP excluded from flow totals while a historical data gap is corrected; holdings still included
observed_claims.oct29_holdings_status: not yet settled at page capture; expected next morning

limitations: Price is a dynamic display captured after market close; no synchronized exchange quote timestamp is exposed in the captured page.
Flow data ends at October 28 and is not a same-day October 29 flow.
Tracker methodology excludes GXRP from flow totals while still including its holdings.
Not independent of the prior canonical XRP Insights tracker source.

candidates.dependency: Uses XRP Insights' holdings/flow dataset; count as one underlying flow source, not two independent confirmations.
limitations: Modeled fund acquisition cost is not shareholder return, actual investor cost basis, price floor, liquidation threshold or proof of a market purchase.
Fund holdings may change due to cash creations, in-kind transfers, fees, index adjustments or data reconstruction.
Share counts and authorized-participant creation/redemption records are needed for stronger flow attribution.

methodology_notes: Tracks direct-XRP funds/ETPs across a broader universe and explicitly excludes diversified basket funds such as BITW.
XRP Insights tracks six US spot funds plus BITW; its universe and treatment of non-US ETPs differ.
The two headline totals are not contradictory by themselves and must not be subtracted or averaged without a fund-by-fund crosswalk.
limitations: The page exposes only the top three fund rows in the free view; remaining fund-level rows require further source inspection.
Fund balances have different as-of dates (Oct 28 or Oct 29).
Tracker totals are not net ETF flow and do not by themselves prove same-day spot purchases.

next_action: Build a fund-level table with issuer, product type, jurisdiction, XRP balance, shares outstanding, as-of date, custody route, basket inclusion/exclusion and creation/redemption evidence. Do not infer price direction from these aggregate totals.
